notes.upper: Method: ExRx roles mapped per brief (Target 1, Synergist .5, Dynamic Stabilizer .3, Stabilizer .15; 'Back, General' target mapped to both lats and traps; Supraspinatus/serratus/pec minor/levator/coracobrachialis ignored). Contreras T-Nation data are n=1 %MVC (heaviest load tested) normalized to the study's highest mean for that muscle (chest composite = mean of upper/mid/lower pec, ref = 115 lb weighted dip 182; triceps ref = rope extension 135; shoulder refs UT 81.9, AD 274, LD 90.7, PD 144; back refs lat 108, biceps 109, mid/lower trap mean 111). Traps from Contreras are split: upper trap from the shoulder article, mid/lower from the back article (both recorded when available). Within-study normalization was used only for muscles where the study contains a direct exercise for that muscle (so e.g. Saeterbakken 2017 gives chest only, Campos 2020 gives front/side delt only; rear delt from Campos skipped since no rear-delt exercise). Volume-method: Pelland 2024 Table 1A classifications (direct 1 / indirect .5), SBS rows->biceps .5, RP Strength articles (front delts indirectly trained by chest exercises; rear delts, traps, biceps indirectly by back/delt work; dips and close-grip bench as compound triceps work), StrengthLog primary (1) / secondary (.5). Surprises/gaps: Contreras DB shrug (100 lb) gave only 0.36 upper-trap vs 315 lb barbell shrug (load-dependent, n=1); rear/side-delt signal during shrugs in Contreras (0.3) judged crosstalk and skipped. Contreras 'Elevated Push Up' assumed to be feet-elevated (decline). Proxies: HSPU uses ExRx Elevated Pike Press (HSPU page premium); Rack Pull uses ExRx Barbell Deadlift (Rack Pull page premium) so quads/hamstrings/adductors roles may be overstated for a rack pull; Pendlay Row uses bent-over-row EMG/ExRx; Low-to-High Cable Fly uses ExRx cable incline fly and Contreras low-pulley crossover; Face Pull uses ExRx rope rear-delt row. Weak exercises (few sources): Landmine Press (StrengthLog only), Pike Push-up (ExRx only), HSPU (ExRx proxy + StrengthLog), Handstand (Kochanowicz forearms 60% MVC; traps/front delt/triceps DERIVED from relative contribution shares - low confidence), Muscle-up (single EMG study normalized to manual muscle test, values >1 capped; chest 1.0 likely inflated), Arnold Press (ExRx, RP, StrengthLog only). Dropped as implausible for hypertrophy: ExRx 'Pectoralis Major, Sternal' synergist in rows/pulldowns/pull-ups (chest), and quads/calves from the deadlift proxy for Rack Pull. ExRx Stabilizer entries (0.15) such as quads/abs in push-ups and hamstrings/glutes in bent-over rows are single-source minor pairs. Youdas 2010 values are lower bounds from reported ranges.
notes.lower: Method: ExRx roles T=1.0/Syn=0.5/DynStab=0.3/Stab=0.15 (antagonist stabilizers skipped); EMG = ratio to the same muscle's highest exercise in that study; when a study had no direct exercise for a muscle, cross-study references were used and are marked: glutes / Neto 2020 barbell hip thrust 82.4 %MVIC, hamstrings / Zebis 2013 leg curl upper value 87% MVC, quads / Stien 2021 leg press mean 89.3 %MVIC (cross-study %MVIC ratios are rough). Volume-method: RP articles classify exercises as direct (1.0) or indirect (0.5) per Pelland 2024 fractional convention; Kubo 2019 and Kinoshita 2023 are MRI hypertrophy studies used as volume-method evidence. PROXY estimates (ExRx page of a closely related exercise) are flagged in the note: Goblet Squat (DB front squat), Walking Lunge (DB lunge), Trap Bar Deadlift (ExRx 'Trap Bar Squat'), Romanian Deadlift (straight-back SLDL, ExRx itself calls it very similar), Sissy Squat (reverse Nordic), Cossack Squat (lunge), Jump Squat and Box Jump (bodyweight squat; ExRx plyometric pages list no muscle roles), Wall Sit (bodyweight squat), Glute Bridge / Single-Leg Glute Bridge (suspended hip bridge), Copenhagen Plank (side plank). ExRx pages that were forbidden/premium or had no role table: sumo deadlift, sissy squat, DB Bulgarian split squat, squat jump, kettlebell swing/goblet (kettlebell pages list only articulations), box jump, sled push. Surprising EMG results kept as-is: cable kickback shows the HIGHEST hamstring (BF) EMG in two studies (Lehecka 2022, Stien 2021) -> kickback hamstrings averages high; leg press glute EMG >= kickback (Stien); hip thrust VL EMG ~= squat (Contreras); hex/trap bar and step-ups exceed hip thrust glute EMG in Neto pooled data; glute-ham raise had the highest erector EMG in McAllister. Kubo 2019: squats produced essentially no hamstring hypertrophy (<1%), so squat hamstring values from ExRx/EMG likely overstate hypertrophy stimulus. Skipped (not plausible hypertrophy load / not listed by ExRx): leg-curl glutes, RDL gastrocnemius, Nordic upper-body 'synergists' of the self-assisted variant, side-plank lats/chest. Grip/forearms for deadlift variants not recorded (no source lists them). Values read from figures (Lehecka 2022) and from Martin-Fuentes 2020 tables are approximate (~). Jump Squat, Box Jump, Sled Push are power/conditioning exercises; their hypertrophy counting rests on proxies or a single conference abstract - consider down-weighting or treating as conditioning.
notes.core:
Method: ExRx roles (T1/Syn0.5/DynStab0.3/Stab0.15); EMG = muscle EMG / max of same muscle in same study (obliques = mean of IO and EO ratios; abs = mean of upper/lower RA when both reported). Volume-method (PELLAND_2024) used only for the obvious prime mover (value 1.0) plus one indirect 0.5 (Russian twist abs).
Judgment calls: (1) CONTRERAS_2010 normalized to max among trunk exercises, excluding chin-ups (LRA 249 looks like crosstalk/outlier) and excluding his 135 lb barbell curl (lowerBack 0.69) and 100 lb cable triceps extension (abs 0.57), which are not plausible hypertrophy loads for those muscles. (2) Low-intensity studies with no exercise targeting a muscle were not used for that muscle (Calatayud ES max 14% MVIC; Ellestad not used for Plank). (3) YUN_2017_DEADBUG has no abdominal reference exercise, so its %MVIC was divided by ESCAMILLA_2006 maxima (cross-study, approximate). (4) Escamilla 2006 latissimus/lumbar/RF columns were garbled in the PDF text, so only RA/EO/IO were used; the paper text says the roll-out also strongly activates lats, but no lats number was recorded for Ab Wheel Rollout (gap).
Proxies: EZ-Bar Curl uses the straight-bar ExRx page; Rope Pushdown uses the bar Cable Pushdown page (rope page is premium); Bicycle Crunch uses ExRx Twisting Crunch; Cable Woodchopper uses ExRx Cable Twist; Mountain Climber uses ExRx Suspended Mountain Climber; Superman lowerBack uses Maeo 'back extension on the floor'; Hollow Hold uses Park 2019 isometric bilateral leg raise; Hanging Knee Raise uses Escamilla 'hanging knee-up with straps' and ACE 'captain's chair'; Ab Wheel uses Escamilla Power Wheel roll-out (kneeling, hands on wheel) and Calatayud stable roll-out plank.
ExRx gaps: premium pages (Farmer's Walk, Ab Wheel Rollout, Rope Pushdown, V-up) and no page for Dead Hang, Dead Bug, Pallof, L-sit, Dragon Flag, Hollow Hold. ExRx rates abs only as a stabilizer (0.15) in leg raises, hanging raises and mountain climbers (target is iliopsoas, which has no key); EMG studies show high abs activity, so averaging will pull these up.
Surprises/conflicts: Pallof press EMG is low (Contreras obliques ~0.18; a Spanish n=1 thesis found all core muscles <~21% MVC), far from the volume-method 1.0. Hammer curl biceps EMG equals the supinated curl (Boeckh-Behrens), while Coratella 2023 shows supinated > neutral > pronated for biceps. In Coratella 2023 brachioradialis was also highest with the supinated grip, which gives Cable Curl forearms 1.0 inside that curl-only study; this likely overstates forearm volume from supinated curls. Farmer's Walk McGill values are peaks that include the deadlift-style pick-up (lats/hamstrings peaked in the lift phase). Farmer's Walk has no traps source found (ExRx page premium, no EMG located), so traps is missing even though it is commonly cited. Sit-up quads 0.5 comes only from ExRx (rectus femoris synergist).
Weak/low-confidence pairs (1 source, main muscle): Russian Twist obliques/abs (only volume-method; one 2026 EMG study had no absolute numbers), L-sit abs (only volume-method), Mountain Climber (all pairs from one ExRx suspended-variant page), Hollow Hold obliques, V-up obliques, Dragon Flag obliques, Dead Bug obliques, Bird Dog obliques/abs, Dead Hang lats/traps/biceps (fingerboard hang study).
Classification: Burpee = kind cardio, muscles [] (ExRx lists it under Cardio exercises; the literature mostly treats burpees as HIIT conditioning, e.g. Bingley et al. JSAMS 2019 sprint vs burpee HIIT). It keeps metric reps 3x10 because burpees are counted in reps; switch to time 1x60 if the app needs all cardio to be time. Jump Rope equipment uses a new tag 'jump rope' so it does not mix with the cable 'rope' attachment. Stretch/Mobility and the cardio items have muscles [] on purpose.
